title: Multi-Agent Orchestration
honesty_note: Orchestration is purely additive to Phase 47: each sub-chain is a ToolChain backed by a SandboxedToolProvider constructed with the sub-task's narrowed AuthorizationScope (via AuthorizationScope::intersect). Sub-chains run sequentially (CPU-first honest default); true parallelism would require a Send+Sync ChainDecoder, which is out of scope for the source release because the InferenceEngine holds a Candle device that is not safely cloneable across threads. The 5 roadmap-named acceptance tests prove the three hard bounds (sub-agent count, total time budget, scope containment) plus aggregation and failure isolation invariants using fake decoders and real sandbox executors, running in milliseconds.
